fusions.name: Flung Third
fusions.desc: Whips the end section of the staff out on its links at the first enemy within 5 tiles. It deals 4 damage, then swings on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Snaking Lash
fusions.desc: Lets the linked sections unfold through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each target for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeling Line
fusions.desc: Lays the unfolded sections in a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Every hit you land wraps a link of the staff's chain round that enemy as a stack, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
